scope: T15 internal query context and availability policy; no public summary endpoint or T17 fact-query implementation

tests.command: gradlew.bat check bootJar --console=plain --init-script <local Mockito temporary-directory init script>

checks: DEFAULT only: newer monthly publication or newest loaded batch does not replace default; MONTH alone remains SUMMARY_DATA_NOT_READY
Published current LOCALITY and registered/supported SEMAS classification checked independently of statistics presence
Source artifact kind, SHA and original collection time checked against successful summary batches
Input format checked before transaction/connection; business required, H10 ASCII10, SEMAS ASCII1+5
Real concurrent selection/default publication preserves initial callback snapshot; new request sees new pointers
Outer READ_COMMITTED transaction is suspended; inner read-only REPEATABLE_READ and caller isolation restored
Population preserved when store classification mismatches; safe integer and actual zero preserved
97 accepted + 3 held count impact => null COUNT_INCOMPLETE; invalid coverage cannot create zero
Source region/row/value absence distinguished from suppression, mapping, boundary, count and quality problems
Reference/default unpublished, broken published metadata and database failure remain distinct errors
limits: Integration uses small deterministic T12/T13/T14 fixtures; no full 2.75-million-row re-import for this read-only change
T17 must query facts, coverage, relevant quality issues and resolve RegionState from actual mapping/boundary evidence inside the callback
T18 must implement HTTP query validation, response/OpenAPI mapping and endpoint tests; no new URL in this branch
No schema migration or changes to existing stored development data
